page.overview:
Who is Denny Hulme?

Denis Clive "Denny" Hulme OBE (born June 18, 1936 in Motueka, New Zealand – died October 4, 1992 in Bathurst, New South Wales, Australia) was a racing driver from New Zealand who raced in Formula One, winning the World Championship in . He drove for only two teams in his career, and . He often raced in the Can-Am series and drove in the Indianapolis 500 four times, finishing fourth twice.

He is the only New Zealander to win the World Championship.
